title: Identity & Belonging
intro: Between one and five a child works out that they are a separate person, and tests whether that is allowed. The no, the wandering off, the coming back — all of it is asking the same question. This month answers it in words short enough to be understood and repeated.

keyScriptures.text: I praise you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made.
I have called you by name; you are mine.

weeks.title: You Are You
weeks.declaration: You are your own person, and that is exactly what God wanted. Nobody else is you, and nobody else could be.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, thank You for who this child is. Help us love the person in front of us. Amen.

weeks.title: You Belong Here
weeks.declaration: This is your home and these are your people. You do not have to be good to belong here.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, let belonging never be something our child has to earn in this house. Amen.

weeks.title: Loved Even When Cross
weeks.declaration: You are loved when you are happy and loved when you are furious. Love does not go away when you are difficult.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, let our love hold steady through the hardest hours of the day. Amen.

weeks.title: God Made You
weeks.declaration: God made you on purpose. He was not in a hurry and He did not make a mistake.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, thank You for making this child exactly as they are. Amen.

days.title: You Are You
days.declaration: You are your own person. Nobody else is you, and nobody else could be.

scripture.text: I am fearfully and wonderfully made.

days.title: God Made You
days.declaration: God made you on purpose. He was not in a hurry and He did not get it wrong.

scripture.text: So God created mankind in his own image.

days.title: You Have a Name
days.declaration: You have a name and it was chosen for you. God knows it too.

scripture.text: I have called you by name; you are mine.

days.title: You Belong Here
days.declaration: This is your home. You belong here and nobody can send you away.

scripture.text: You are members of God's household.

days.title: Loved When Cross
days.declaration: You are loved when you are happy. You are loved when you are cross too.

scripture.text: Nothing can separate us from the love of God.

days.title: Not Too Loud
days.declaration: You are not too loud or too much. You are exactly the right amount of you.

scripture.text: Shout for joy to the Lord, all the earth.

days.title: Wanted
days.declaration: We wanted you before you were here. We are glad you came.

scripture.text: Children are a heritage from the Lord.

days.title: God Sees You
days.declaration: God sees you all the time, and He likes what He sees.

scripture.text: You are the God who sees me.

days.title: You Are Safe
days.declaration: You are safe here. There is nothing in this house you need to be afraid of.

scripture.text: You alone, Lord, make me dwell in safety.

days.title: Your Own Face
days.declaration: There is nobody with your face. God only made one of you.

scripture.text: You knit me together in my mother's womb.

days.title: A Child of God
days.declaration: You are a child of God. That is who you are, even when you forget.

scripture.text: He gave the right to become children of God.

days.title: Big Feelings Are Allowed
days.declaration: Your big feelings are allowed here. You can be sad or angry and still be loved.

scripture.text: Pour out your hearts to him.

days.title: You Can Come Back
days.declaration: When you run off, you can always come back. The door does not close.

scripture.text: While he was still a long way off, his father saw him.

days.title: God Is Happy About You
days.declaration: God is not just putting up with you. He is happy you are here.

scripture.text: He will take great delight in you.

days.title: Nothing to Earn
days.declaration: You do not have to be good to be loved. You are loved first.

scripture.text: We love because he first loved us.

days.title: You Are Growing
days.declaration: You are getting bigger every day. God is helping you do it.

scripture.text: The child grew and became strong.

days.title: Held When You Fall
days.declaration: When you fall over, someone picks you up. That is what we are here for.

scripture.text: The Lord upholds him with his hand.

days.title: Your Place at the Table
days.declaration: There is a place at this table that is yours. It is always yours.

scripture.text: You prepare a table before me.

days.title: Made Different
days.declaration: You are not the same as anyone else, and that is a good thing.

scripture.text: God has placed the parts just as he wanted them.

days.title: God Knows Your Name
days.declaration: God knows your name and He never forgets it.

scripture.text: I have engraved you on the palms of my hands.

days.title: You Are Enough
days.declaration: You are enough right now. You do not have to be bigger to be loved.

scripture.text: My grace is sufficient for you.

days.title: Someone Is Glad
days.declaration: Someone is glad to see you every single day. That is not going to stop.

scripture.text: The Lord make his face shine on you.

days.title: You Are Not a Bother
days.declaration: You are not a bother. Wanting us is not a problem.

scripture.text: Let the little children come to me.

days.title: Small Is Fine
days.declaration: Being small is fine. God is not waiting for you to be big.

scripture.text: See that you do not despise one of these little ones.

days.title: Your Body Is Good
days.declaration: Your hands, your feet, your voice — God made all of it and it is good.

scripture.text: Your works are wonderful.

days.title: We Are Your People
days.declaration: We are your people, and you are ours. That does not change.

scripture.text: Your people will be my people.

days.title: Loved Every Day
days.declaration: You are loved on good days and hard days. Every day, all the way through.

scripture.text: His mercies are new every morning.

days.title: God Has Plans
days.declaration: God has good plans for you. You do not need to know them yet.

scripture.text: I know the plans I have for you.

days.title: You Are Precious
days.declaration: You are precious. That means very, very special.

scripture.text: You are precious and honoured in my sight.

days.title: God Will Not Leave
days.declaration: God will never go away from you. Not ever, not once.

scripture.text: Never will I leave you; never will I forsake you.

days.title: Said Again Tomorrow
days.declaration: All of this is still true tomorrow. We will say it again.

scripture.text: Talk about them when you sit at home.
